widgets_values:
A cartoon presenter delivering an engaging explanation directly to the camera.

Preserve the character's appearance, art style, face, hairstyle and clothing from the reference image.

Fixed camera, stable waist-up composition. Both hands and forearms remain fully visible, with enough space around the torso for gestures.

The presenter speaks with natural mouth movements, gentle blinking and subtle head nods.

While speaking, the presenter makes clearly visible, relaxed explanatory hand gestures. One hand lifts to chest level with an open palm to introduce a point, gently moves outward to emphasize the explanation, then returns to a relaxed position. At other moments, both hands open slightly with palms facing upward, as if presenting an idea.

Alternate short gestures with brief resting pauses. The hands move smoothly and naturally with the rhythm of speech. Keep the gestures moderate, varied and easy to read, without constant waving.

The torso stays centered while the shoulders, elbows, forearms and hands move naturally. Maintain consistent hand anatomy and character proportions.

Uniform solid green background, flat and evenly lit. Keep the background and lighting unchanged throughout the video.

singing, dancing, walking, exaggerated acting,
frantic waving, rapid repetitive gestures, flailing arms,
hands covering the face, hands leaving the frame,
camera movement, zoom, cuts, scene changes,
face distortion, changing clothes, changing character design,
deformed hands, fused fingers, extra fingers, extra arms,
jerky motion, flickering, blurry face,

subtitles, text, watermark

widgets_values:
This node makes the sampling into a loop to process all the needed frames. Each window is the same size, if the frame count doesn't divide evenly the audio will be padded with silence and extra frames generated.

Between each window the frames have to be re-encoded, thus no latents are saved and end result is already decoded.

You can also set an output_path to save each window's result as images during the process.
